PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE DATO_HH AS /*DATO A HOGARES*/
SELECT AÑO,MES,RUN,SUBSTR(RUN,1,4) AS RUN_SDV,SUM(CASE WHEN DESTINO='EMPRE_HOGAR' THEN PATRI_T/2 ELSE PATRI_T END) AS DATO,tipo_fondo
FROM base_datos WHERE DESTINO IN ('HOGARES','EMPRE_HOGAR') GROUP BY AÑO,MES,RUN,tipo_fondo;
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE DATO_TOT AS /*DATO TOTAL*/
SELECT AÑO,MES,RUN,SUBSTR(RUN,1,4) AS RUN_SDV,SUM(PATRI_T) AS DATO
PROC SQL; CREATE TABLE DATO_EST AS
FROM DATO_HH T1, DATO_TOT T2 WHERE T1.AÑO=T2.AÑO AND T1.MES=T2.MES AND T1.RUN=T2.RUN;

proc sql; create table data_dep_run as
from data_fm t1 left join id_fm t2 on (t1.run_fondo=t2.run_fondo)
where t1.t_instcorto in ('DPC','DPL') and t1.mes in (3,6,9,12) group by t1.año,t1.mes,t1.run_fondo,t2.Sector;
proc sql; create table data_dep as
select año,mes/3 as trim,sector,sum(dato) as dato
proc sql; create table DEP_HH AS
select t1.año,t1.mes/3 as trim,t2.sector,sum(t1.est*t2.dato) as dato
from DATO_EST t1,data_dep_run t2 where t1.año=t2.año and t1.mes=t2.mes and t1.run_sdv=t2.run_fondo and t1.año>=2017
proc sql; create table DEP_HH_2 AS
select t2.año,t2.mes/3 as trim,t2.sector,sum(t1.est*t2.dato) as dato
from DATO_EST t1,data_dep_run t2 where t1.año=t2.año  and t1.run_sdv=t2.run_fondo and t2.año<2017
proc sql; create table dep_hh_fm as	/*% total para dep de hogares*/
from DEP_HH t1,data_dep t2 where t1.año=t2.año and t1.trim=t2.trim and t1.sector=t2.sector;
proc sql; create table imputa as select 2005 as año,t1.trim,t1.Sector,t1.dato
from  dep_hh_fm t1 where t1.año=2006 and t1.trim=1;quit;
proc sql; create table imputa_2 as select 2004 as año,t1.trim,t1.Sector,t1.dato
from  dep_hh_fm t1 where t1.año=2006 and t1.trim=1;quit;
proc sql; create table imputa_3 as select 2003 as año,t1.trim,t1.Sector,t1.dato
from  dep_hh_fm t1 where t1.año=2006 and t1.trim=1;quit;
data imputa; set imputa imputa_2 imputa_3;run;
proc sql; update imputa_a set trim=2;quit;
proc sql; update imputa_b set trim=3;quit;
proc sql; update imputa_c set trim=4;quit;
data dep_hh_fm;set dep_hh_fm imputa imputa_a imputa_b imputa_c;run; /*genera base serie completa*/
